scope: Retrospective pilot diagnostic. Battle-disjoint development and scoring subsets assigned by sorted battle ID before ablation calculation; historical pooled outcomes and aggregate scores already known, so no claim of fresh holdout. No floor or strength tuning. Fresh stage2 battles will be scored separately.
selection_rule: sorted unique battle identifiers, alternate whole games; both perspectives remain in same subset
assumptions: No final unseen transition scored; target facts enter only after pre-reveal prediction captured.
